featured_reviews.name: Anees Rizvi
featured_reviews.review_text: I had a disappointing experience with this cake shop. I ordered a custom cake for my daughter’s First Birthday and I wanted it to be special, specifying the design and flavors I wanted. However, what I received was completely different from what I had requested. The cake was not only unacceptable , but the decoration was also unrecognizable. When I reached out to address the issue, the response was unhelpful and dismissive. This experience left me feeling frustrated and let down on a day that was supposed to be special. I wouldn’t recommend this shop if you’re looking for reliable service and quality. The first picture is what Libon Cake shop made and the second picture is the reference that I gave them, they made the unicorn horn in mustard yellow instead of golden, did not write Happy Birthday in fondant as requested and to top it all changed the entire theme which made the cake look cheap.

featured_reviews.name: Misbah Ali Asgar
featured_reviews.review_text:
We recently ordered a 2.5 kg premium chocolate cake from Libon for our daughter’s birthday, and it was absolutely amazing! At first, we were a bit unsure after reading some negative reviews, so we spoke to the team about our concerns. They assured us they would do their best, and they truly delivered!

The mermaid-themed cake was beautifully designed... The taste was rich, perfectly balanced, and not overloaded with cream. The outer layer had a touch of fondant for decoration, but the inside was pure, indulgent chocolate. Every bite was heavenly!

Everyone at the party kept asking where the cake was from... This was, without a doubt, the best birthday cake we’ve had in the last 10 years. Huge thanks to the Libon team and their cake chef for such excellent work. Highly recommended!

(You can check out the pictures—this cake was as delicious as it looked!)

featured_reviews.name: Rehan Mistry
featured_reviews.review_text:
⚠️ Food Safety Warning – Libon (via Swiggy) ⚠️

I had a terrible experience with Libon and wanted to share this so others can be careful.

I ordered Kunafa for my baby through Swiggy, and when we opened the box, we were shocked to find fungus on it. When I called the restaurant directly, they tried to brush it off by saying it was just "pista" (pistachio). I told them to come and eat it themselves if they really believed that.

Eventually, the shopkeeper admitted the fridge was broken, blamed the staff for packing stale food, and realized the mistake. He offered to replace the item, but by then the damage was done. I told him, “Thanks, but you can eat the spoiled food yourself.”

This was my last order from Libon. They clearly don’t check what they’re serving, and that’s not something anyone should risk—especially when feeding kids.

Please think twice before ordering from or eating at Libon. Food safety should never be compromised.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I had visited this place on 29/09/25.
I purchased tandoori roll, chicken pattices and red thai chicken pattices.
I told the girl at the counter to warm the stuff as i wanted to eat it.
When i started eating the tandoori roll, the bread was not fresh, a bit hard, not able to bite it.
The pattices had filling only in the centre, edges were empty and didnt appear fresh.  I noticed that the pattices were not warmed but the girl at the counter just pretended to do so.
I didnt buy anything else as the food items didnt look good.
I kept wondering whether it was really Merwans pattices or just something sold in the name of Merwans Since I was in a hurry, i didnt go back to complain.
Had to throw away all what i purchased.
Very very disappointing Merwans, Mira Road. Stop cheating people!

Learn from Merwans Andheri east branch. They sell fresh stuff and their service is awesome and they have all the Merwans food items unlike the pathetic 'not so Merwans'  outlet.

featured_reviews.name: Sharon Paul
featured_reviews.review_text: Took a takeaway for chicken tandoori lattice, chicken Russian cutlets and the chicken white sauce cup pastry, the % of chicken in all 3 items was probably just 10% of the entire filling. featured_reviews.review_text:
I love all *Our Daily Bread outlet Mira road products but the assorted chocolate brownie 6pc box has been my all time favourite and truly justifies it's name with its rich chocolate gooeyness.Our Daily Bread Mira road is truly one of our favourite place. Always a delight coming here for desserts. This outlet may not be very spacious but their desserts are lip smacking good. Loved the new York Cheesecake slice among the ones I tried . Value for money and a must visit place.
Our Daily Bread Mira road is an outlet which will always top our priority list Scrumptious Belgian chocolate mousse that melt in your mouth leaving you a heavenly sensation exactly what visiting Our Daily Bread Mira road feels like. Value for money, nice Ambience, pocket - friendly ,friendly staff always ready to assist you.
Worth a visit,!

featured_reviews.name: Binson K Thomas
featured_reviews.review_text: This is easily one of the best bakeries in Mira Road! They have so many fresh varieties of bakery products and everything is top quality. Their multigrain bread loaves are a staple for me, and the pastries are always fresh and delicious. I’ve also noticed they have a great range of other items like macaroons and brownies that are definitely worth trying. Whether you're looking for daily bread or a sweet treat, this place never disappoints!

featured_reviews.name: Jerin Varghese
featured_reviews.review_text: The New York & the Biscoff Cheesecakes is a must try here! It's really good for the pricing. Things are well priced, it isn't that costly.. Tried one of their chicken pattice, and it tasted quite well. A nice substitute to the Merwans pattice.

featured_reviews.review_text: I love the dessert here. I tried the fish and chips but didn't enjoy it much. I think tarte sauce could be better. Pizza was ok. The place and location is awesome, food could be better.
